conflicts.description: Both primary sources state the period only as between March 14 and March 15, 2025, with no clock time or timezone. A second-resolution boundary would be fabricated; a narrow reading could exclude runs the publisher counts as inside the period.
conflicts.rationale: The dates are read as UTC calendar days with an exclusive end boundary after March 15, encoded as day precision with the conservative-expanded approximation and the original claim retained, so the expansion is visible rather than represented as the publisher's observation.
